data.narrative:
PILGRIM is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Jake Adler that has raised $4.3M to date. The comparable universe consists of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the same sector and stage, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, alongside public references DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two valuation methods triangulate a range. Stage-progression applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from the $4M raised proxy, implying $11M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a $700M median, with a distribution spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $9M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $355M. The substantial spread reflects material uncertainty inherent in Seed-stage valuation. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively to capital deployed; the peer-median method captures sector-specific risk and recent capital availability in Defense & Security but is sensitive to the wide dispersion in comparable valuations, particularly the $4.0B outlier. Key uncertainties include PILGRIM's differentiation relative to well-funded peers, product-market validation progress, and realized defensibility versus comparable-stage entrants.
